title: 2 Feature Requests  AOD & Alarms
symptom: User requests two features: 1) showing full xDrip notification text (sugar level + trend) on the Always On Display (AOD) for AMOLED devices, not just the xDrip icon; 2) outsourcing alarms into a second app (e.g., 'Xdrip_alarm') or a setting to allow separate notification settings for steady notifications and alarms.
fix: The issue was closed after jamorham noted that half of the items are addressed by the notification number feature. No specific fix was described.
evidence_quote: I believe half of the items in this issue are now addressed by the notification number feature.
